title: The Tiny Horse Contest
paragraphs: Maya loved painting tiny things.
Her desk was full of little paint pots and thin brushes.
One day, her art teacher told the class about a contest.
“Make a tiny horse,” said Mr. Reed.
“The best one will win a prize.”
Maya rushed home after school.
She found a small gray horse made of clay.
She painted its body brown.
She added a white spot on its nose and a long black tail.
When she picked it up, her hand slipped.
The horse fell to the floor, and one leg snapped off!
Maya was so unhappy.
She wanted to quit.
Then she looked at the broken leg again.
“I can fix this,” she said.
She used a drop of glue to put the leg back on.
Then she repainted the crack with brown paint.
Now no one could see it.
On the day of the contest, Mr. Reed held up each horse.
When he got to Maya’s horse, he smiled.
“Look at the white spot on its nose,” he said.
“This horse looks real!”
Maya won second place.
She felt proud, because she did not give up.
